visualCharacteristics.layout: Two side-by-side columns (1/3 + 2/3), stacked on mobile: left is a video poster image with a play overlay and a caption (e.g. "(c) Continental AG"); right is text paragraphs ending with a pill CTA button. With a video.continental.com link the poster is a click-to-play button that swaps in the player iframe; otherwise the poster links to the video/media page

contentPattern: One row, two cells: cell 1 = poster image + caption paragraph (+ link); cell 2 = paragraphs + CTA link. The video link may sit in either cell: a https://video.continental.com/?v={uuid} link makes the poster click-to-play (iframe, nothing third-party before the click; a stand-alone link paragraph is folded into the poster). Any other link (e.g. the media-library page) keeps the previous behaviour: the poster links to it. Shared helper: /scripts/video-embed.js
